why:
scrapy/scrapy PR #6867, created 2025-06-06 10:19:55: https://github.com/scrapy/scrapy/pull/6867
The fix in scrapy/core/engine.py (base d602f13e8c) changed line(s) 177:
  - self.downloader.close()
  + if hasattr(self, "downloader"):
  + self.downloader.close()
Problem: ExecuteEngine.close() assumes self.downloader has been defined https://github.com/scrapy/scrapy/blob/8fb8d2c6b8a83181ef6564fbc9afa9cfeea2bd05/scrapy/core/engine.py#L177 However, `self.close()` is called in the `finally` block where `self.downloader` is set, so that may not be always the case. Found 
Check the fix is the bug, and visible from this file alone, before removing draft.
